description: A small white square table-like model with four upright block “legs” sits on a green mat in front of you. The left hand reaches in and grasps a small white block from the front-left area of the model as the right hand rests on the front edge to steady it; then the left hand lifts the block up and slides it leftward away from the base, releasing it off to the side while the right hand keeps contact with the model.
